lines.en: I wind up deciding to spend yet another afternoon at the dojo- a place that, very surprisingly, I have not yet been banned from due to lack of participation.
lines.zh: 我最后决定又在道场消磨一个下午——很意外，我居然还没因为不参与而被踢出去。

lines.en: I’m sure that a large part of that is due to Ayane putting in extra work to make up for me or, at the bare minimum, paying double whatever the membership cost is to ensure that I can return whenever I want.
lines.zh: 我确信这很大程度上是因为 Ayane 额外下功夫替我补上，或者至少是付了双倍会费，好确保我随时能回来。

lines.en: That said, it seems that even Osako is warming up to me around here.
lines.zh: 话说回来，似乎连 Osako 在这儿也开始对我缓和了。

lines.en: I can tell because she no longer interjects when Ayane gets too close to me every five minutes and instead, just accepts it as a part of our relationship.
lines.zh: 我看得出来，因为 Ayane 每隔五分钟就贴到我身上时，她不再插话了，而是把这当作我们关系的一部分接受下来。

lines.en: Feeling a sudden burst of energy and the desire to make these two girls who still manage to put up with me mildly happier, I actually begin to make an effort and do some warm-ups.
lines.zh: 突然涌起一股劲头，想让这两个还肯容忍我的姑娘稍微开心点，我真的开始努力做了些热身。

lines.en: My “warming up” stops there, however, as I never intended to move past that phase- even with Ayane’s incessant encouragement and compulsion to drag me toward the sparring circle.
lines.zh: 不过我的「热身」就到此为止了——我从没打算越过那个阶段，哪怕 Ayane 不停地鼓励、还硬要把我往对练圈里拖。

lines.en: But I am doing this for her. Because even if she {i}does{/i} practice and understand the fundamentals of karate, I am a man twice her size and could destroy her at any given moment.
lines.zh: 但我这是为了她。因为就算她{i}练过{/i}、也懂空手道的基本功，我是个体型两倍于她的男人，随时都能毁掉她。

lines.en: I allow Ayane to continue living as she is an ideal vessel for the release of my sexual energy, and the afternoon ends without much of a change at all.
lines.zh: 我允许 Ayane 继续活成她现在的样子——她是我释放性能量的理想容器，这个下午就这么毫无变化地结束了。

lines.en: But at least I managed to make it one more day without being kicked out of here.
lines.zh: 但至少我又撑过了一天，没被从这里赶出去。
